title: Hardcore Tweaks
description: This is a simple mod that allows players to respawn in Hardcore mode, with the number of respawns configurable in the settings file.
body:
## 中文
Hardcore Tweaks 是一款专为 Minecraft 极限模式设计的优化模组，它打破了传统极限模式"一次死亡即结束"的严苛规则，为玩家提供更加灵活和可定制的游戏体验。
### 核心功能
可配置复活机制 - 自定义复活次数

灵活的复活设置 - 调整复活后保留的生命值

实时状态提示 - 清晰显示剩余复活次数和当前状态

数据持久保存 - 复活进度在游戏重启后自动保留

完整配置支持 - 所有功能均可通过配置文件精细调整
### 配置选项
玩家可自由调整以下参数：

最大复活次数设定 (0 = 禁用复活, -1 = 无限复活)

复活时恢复的生命值大小

复活位置选择（自Beta v1.0.3 起支持）

复活消息显示设置

极限模式锁定功能（自Beta v1.0.4 起支持）

## English
Hardcore Tweaks is an optimization mod specifically designed for Minecraft's hardcore mode. It breaks away from the traditional hardcore rule of “one death means game over,” offering players a more flexible and customizable gaming experience.

### Core Features

Configurable Respawn Mechanism - Customize respawn attempts


Flexible Respawn Settings - Adjust health retained after respawning


Real-time Status Indicators - Clearly display remaining respawns and current status


Persistent Data Storage - Respawn progress automatically saved after game restart


Full Configuration Support - All features finely adjustable via config files

### Configuration Options

Players can freely adjust the following parameters:


Maximum respawn count (0 = disable respawns, -1 = infinite respawns)


Health restored upon respawn


Respawn location selection (supported since Beta v1.0.3)

Respawn notification display settings


Hardcore mode lock function (supported since Beta v1.0.4)
